record.oneLiner: The first meat-eating dinosaur found in Antarctica.
record.description: Cryolophosaurus was a large theropod of the Early Jurassic of Antarctica, 6–7 m long, with a distinctive crest running across the top of its skull. It was the first carnivorous dinosaur discovered on the continent and the first Antarctic dinosaur to be formally named.

notableFacts.text: The first carnivorous dinosaur discovered in Antarctica.
Had an unusual crest running side-to-side across its skull.
